text: {"fixed_clause": "The company retains submitted candidate records and application files in our archival database following the conclusion of the recruitment cycle, and must destroy this personal data without undue delay once it is no longer necessary for the purpose of collection, unless a legal retention requirement or pending judicial case applies."}
